class.name: LocaleOptionButton
class.brief_description: A language menu that lists the locales of the project under their native names.
class.description: [LocaleOptionButton] is an [OptionButton] that fills itself with the locales a player can choose: the locales of the localization catalogs and of the loaded translations ([method LanguageSettingsServer.get_available_locales_for] for the [member target] channel). It is built from what is loaded, not from the file system, so it works the same on every platform including the Web. Selecting an entry sets the locale of the [member target] locale channel (see [method TranslationServer.set_locale_for]): an empty target is the language of the game, [code]interface[/code], [code]audio[/code] and [code]subtitles[/code] are stored by [LanguageSettingsServer] (the choice is saved and applied again on the next start), a custom channel is set directly with [method TranslationServer.set_locale_for]. The selected entry follows [signal TranslationServer.locale_changed], also when the locale is changed from code or by another [LocaleOptionButton]. Names are shown in their own language ([code]Deutsch[/code], [code]Français[/code], [code]日本語[/code]); languages without an entry use the English name of the engine. Locales of the same language, for example [code]de_DE[/code] and [code]de_AT[/code], get their country added. [b]Note:[/b] In the editor the list stays empty, because its items would be saved into the scene and a selection must not change the language of the editor. [codeblocks] [gdscript] var menu = LocaleOptionButton.new() menu.target = &"subtitles" menu.locale_selected.connect(func(locale): print("Subtitles: ", locale)) add_child(menu) [/gdscript] [csharp] var menu = new LocaleOptionButton(); menu.Target = "subtitles"; menu.LocaleSelected += (locale) => GD.Print("Subtitles: ", locale); AddChild(menu); [/csharp] [/codeblocks]

method.name: get_locales
method.description: Returns the locales of the entries, in the order of the list.

method.name: get_native_name
method.description: Returns the name of [param locale] in its own language, for example [code]Deutsch[/code] for [code]de_AT[/code] or [code]Português (Brasil)[/code] for [code]pt_BR[/code]. If the language is not known, returns [method TranslationServer.get_locale_name]. With [param include_region], the English name of the country is added ([code]Deutsch (Austria)[/code]), except for names that contain it already.

method.name: get_selected_locale
method.description: Returns the locale of the selected entry, or an empty string if no entry is selected.

method.name: refresh
method.description: Builds the list again from the current locales of the project and selects the entry of the active locale. Call it after adding catalogs or translations while the button is in the scene tree; it runs by itself when the button enters the tree and when a property that changes the list is set. Does nothing in the editor.

method.name: select_locale
method.description: Selects the entry of [param locale], or of the closest locale in the list, without changing the language. Selects nothing if no entry matches.

members.member: If [code]true[/code], the fallback locale ([method TranslationServer.get_fallback_locale]) is listed even if no catalog or translation has it.

If [code]true[/code], entries show the name of the locale in its own language (see [method get_native_name]). If [code]false[/code], they show the English name of the engine ([method TranslationServer.get_locale_name]).
If [code]true[/code], the country is added to every name. Locales of the same language always get it.

The locale channel this menu sets: empty for the language of the game, [code]interface[/code], [code]audio[/code], [code]subtitles[/code] or a custom channel (see [method TranslationServer.set_locale_for]). The list contains the locales that have texts of the channel (see [method LanguageSettingsServer.get_available_locales_for]).

signal.name: locale_selected
signal.description: Emitted when the player selects an entry, after the locale of the [member target] was set.
